name: Neo800+ · Neo450s
summary: Large-format SLA for accurate prototypes, wind-tunnel models and casting patterns. Neo450s: 450 × 450 × 400 mm.

page.description: Stratasys Neo800+ · Neo450s 3D printer from IME Additive Manufacturing, Malaysia: specifications, applications and pricing.
page.headline: Large-format SLA,
page.lead: Open-resin stereolithography for accurate prototypes, jigs and investment-casting patterns. Neo800+ builds up to 800 × 800 × 600 mm with a 4 W laser; Neo450s fits 450 × 450 × 400 mm into a compact frame.
page.footnote: Source: stratasys.com Neo series and Neo450s pages, read 10 Nov 2026.
page.features_heading: Smooth surfaces, sharp detail, any 355 nm resin.

features.title: Open resin system
features.text: Runs commercially available 355 nm SLA resins, including Somos.

features.title: Titanium software
features.text: Real-time updates, reports and remote diagnostics.

features.title: Fast scanning (Neo800+)
features.text: Up to 20 m/s; up to 50 % faster builds (Stratasys claim).

benefits.title: Less post-processing
benefits.text: Up to 50 % less on Neo450s (Stratasys claim).

benefits.title: Material freedom
benefits.text: Choose the resin for each job.

specs.label: Laser
specs.value: Solid-state frequency-tripled Nd:YVO4, 355 nm; Neo800+ 4 W, Neo450s 2 W

specs.label: Scan speed
specs.value: Neo800+ up to 20 m/s · Neo450s up to 10 m/s

specs.label: Materials
specs.value: Open 355 nm resin system; Somos resins recommended (e.g. WaterShed XC 11122, WaterShed AF, Taurus, EvoLVe 128, PerFORM)

specs.label: Software
specs.value: Titanium, GrabCAD, Materialise Magics; Windows 10 IoT Enterprise

applications.title: Investment casting
applications.text: Master patterns, e.g. in antimony-free Somos WaterShed AF.
